digest.component_or_area: inbound reconciliation differ and snapshot enrichment
propositions: A parent removed in Jira is never cleared from the local parent_id field because two independent layers drop the signal: the fetcher omits absent parents from the snapshot and the differ refuses to emit parent_id=None
The fetcher's parent enrichment leaves the parent field absent when mapped to None, making a de-parented issue indistinguishable from one that never had a parent
The inbound differ skips emitting parent_id=None to avoid spurious clears when parent keys are not yet bound, but this blanket guard also prevents clearing when a parent was genuinely removed
The apply layer is ready to handle parent clears (mapping parent_id through falsy to empty string), but no clear signal reaches it
An inbound parent clear requires positive evidence the peer once had the parent, not merely the absence of data, to avoid destroying local parents on degraded reads or truncated snapshots
The same-pass outbound-to-inbound field suppression must protect against clearing a locally-set parent while the differ is writing an outbound parent mutation in the same pass
